correctness.rationale: The affine normal form is x=0, y=0, x+y=c with c=0 or 1; changing coordinates on the frequency plane preserves the sum of kernel magnitudes. With the stated q⁻² normalization the complex operator norm is the absolute row sum, attained by a conjugate-phase input. Inclusion–exclusion gives pencil numerator values 3q−2, q−2, and −2 with multiplicities 1, 3(q−1), and (q−1)(q−2). For the triangle the origin contributes 3q−3 and the three punctured exceptional directions each contribute A_q; off those directions the contribution is B_q. Root-of-unity multiplicity q/p and correction for the common origin give A_q=(q/p)U_p(q)−(q−3) for q≥3 and B_q=(q/p)²R_p−3(q/p)T_p+6, yielding the claimed constant correction +12. Independently checked the second moments: on one punctured direction it is (q−1)(q−2)²+3q−5, and off all three it is 3q²−15q+18. Cauchy–Schwarz gives the stated A_q and strict B_q bounds; the gap lower polynomial is positive at q=4 and increasing thereafter. At q=3 the off-direction magnitudes vanish and the triangle numerator absolute sum is 6+6√3; at q=2 the pencil is the whole plane and the triangular magnitudes are 3,1,1,1 before q⁻². The characteristic-two reduction and fixed-p limit follow by the stated root sums; the O(1/q) remainder for U_p follows from cancellation of the real parts of the p-th roots. Read the supporting verification and checker without running the uploaded code. Its finite checks do not underwrite the universal comparison.
